---
title: "Best MAGs Planktothrix"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-02-07"
---
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
```


Read GTDB file
```{r}
gtdb <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output/339MAGs/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv", header = TRUE)

# Extract genus name from classification string
gtdb$genus <- sub(".*;g__([^;]+).*", "\\1", gtdb$classification)

```


Still need contigs, can get it from checkm
```{r}
checkm <- read.csv(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/checkm_dastool_all20_combined.csv",
  colClasses = c(culture = "character", genome_base = "character")
)

checkm <- checkm %>%
  mutate(
    old_bin_name = genome_base,

    # Remove the old metaSPAdes wording
    genome_base = str_remove(genome_base, "_metaSPAdes"),

    # Rename numeric CONCOCT bins
    genome_base = if_else(
      str_detect(genome_base, "^\\d+(_sub)?$"),
      paste0(culture, "_concoct.", genome_base),
      genome_base
    )
  )

```


Now keep all columns from checkm but only keep bins that are in gtdb
```{r}

final_data <- checkm %>%
  semi_join(gtdb, by = c("genome_base" = "user_genome")) %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb %>% 
      dplyr::select(user_genome, genus, classification),
    by = c("genome_base" = "user_genome")
  ) 


```


Rename and organize columns
```{r}
final_data <- final_data %>%
  rename(
    `Bin Identity` = `genus`,
    `Culture Origin` = `genome_base`,
    `Bin completeness` = `completeness`,
    `Bin contamination` = `contamination`,
    `Number of contigs` = `number_of_contigs`,
    `Size of genome (bp)` = `genome_size_bp`,
    `GTDB Classification` = `classification`
  )

#order it
final_data <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Bin Identity`, 
    `Culture Origin`, 
    `Bin completeness`, 
    `Bin contamination`, 
    `Number of contigs`, 
    `Size of genome (bp)`,
    `GTDB Classification`
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Bin Identity`)

```



export
```{r}
write.csv(final_data, "339_MAGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gtdb, "GTDB_output.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
